name: Netie.AI
description: Netie.AI product landing plus scoped software and analysis work by Jian Hong Oo in Penang. Written scope before payment. Cortex crews, in-house LLM, document systems, and Vanguard/Closer/Cortex-class builds can be quoted for other companies. Not a SaaS licence, not a retrieval API, and not a production warehouse.
agent_instructions: Read this catalog. Do not invent prices or case studies. Do not send passwords, API keys, or customer files. Email a non-sensitive brief or open the human brief form. Humans still confirm scope before any Stripe checkout.

offers.name: Catalogue and website copywriting
offers.deliverable: Product names, services pages, and short web copy from published facts. English first. Malay and Mandarin when the page needs it.

price.note: quoted after looking at the live copy

offers.name: Records operations and data capture
offers.deliverable: Type, clean, and hand back an agreed catalogue, CRM sheet, or product list. Bad rows are parked, not deleted. Not an Excel find-the-cell hunt.

price.note: quoted after looking at the list

offers.name: Software documentation and runbooks
offers.deliverable: README, operator notes, or a short internal guide from live screens and the repo.

price.note: quoted after looking at the tool

offers.name: Business website or landing page
offers.deliverable: A services or landing page from approved published facts. Band depends on how much copy, layout, and extra page or small chat is required.

price.note: quoted after looking at the live site

offers.name: CI, pull requests, and bugs
offers.deliverable: Read a failing GitHub Action, a pull request, or a scoped bug. Written triage, then an agreed patch if that is in the same job.

price.note: quoted after looking at the repo or workflow

offers.name: Document cleaning, lineage, and cited answers
offers.deliverable: Clean an agreed extract, keep row IDs, park exceptions, and answer only from the cleaned table.

offers.name: Internal operations system
offers.deliverable: Agreed data model, API, admin area, and team screens for one defined workflow.

offers.name: Cortex crew and agent coordination
offers.deliverable: A small crew of named agents with a human confirm step, built for the buyer's process. Public proof is the Suite Cortex panel and projects page, not a hosted live-agent API.

offers.name: In-house LLM (AirGPT-class)
offers.deliverable: Private chat and control surface on customer-controlled machines. Same class as AirGPT. Jumpwin customer records are not a public demo.

offers.name: Document system (DMS-class)
offers.deliverable: Governed answers over an agreed extract or Space, with lineage, parked exceptions, and a refuse path. Private DMS GitHub is not public from this token.

offers.name: Enterprise agent suite (Vanguard, Closer, Cortex)
offers.deliverable: In-house Netriprise-style agents for signals, sales execution, and reasoning over the buyer's sources. Public proof is Suite panels, /projects/, and IntroVid.mp4.
